name: uk.co.nationalnumbers/registration-tools
title: National Numbers - Private Number Plates
description: UK number plate search, availability, registration formatting, valuations and transfer guidance.

tools.name: suggest_registrations
tools.description: Given a name, word, or initials, intelligently suggests number plates that would make for a good match.

query.description: A name, word or initials containing only letters, numbers and spaces

min_price_gbp.description: Optional floor price. Only registrations with asking prices greater than this figure will be returned.

max_price_gbp.description: Optional ceiling price. Only registrations with asking prices less than this figure will be returned. If omitted, no maximum price limit is applied.

registration_types.description: Optional plate formats to restrict matching to. If omitted, matching plates of all formats will be returned.

available_only.description: Return only registrations currently available. Defaults to false if omitted.

registration.description: The vehicle's current registration mark, used to determine its age.

first_registered_on.description: The vehicle's exact first-registration date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

first_registered_year.description: The vehicle's known first-registration year. Treated conservatively as the start of that year.

vehicle_age_reference.description: Optional vehicle-age restriction. Results will only include registrations suitable for a vehicle of this age. Provide the vehicle's current registration, its first registration date (YYYY-MM-DD), or year of registration. When only a year is supplied, later registration releases from that same year will be excluded.

sort_by.description: Field used to order search results. Defaults to relevance.

sort_order.description: Direction used to order search results.

tools.name: lookup_registration
tools.description: Given a number plate registration, confirm validity and return the plate format, age identifier, year of issue, region/local office information and notes.

registration.description: A UK vehicle number plate registration (e.g. A 1, S7 EVE, MY51 REG)

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Given a number plate registration, confirm validity and return details of its current availability, pricing, and any additional information about the registration.

registration.description: A UK vehicle number plate registration (e.g. A 1, S7 EVE, MY51 REG)

tools.name: format_registration
tools.description: Given a number plate registration, correctly space and format it for legal UK road use.

registration.description: A UK vehicle number plate registration (e.g. A 1, S7 EVE, MY51 REG)

tools.name: bulk_format_registration
tools.description: Given multiple number plate registrations, correctly space and format them for legal UK road use.

items.description: A UK vehicle number plate registration (e.g. A 1, S7 EVE, MY51 REG)

registrations.description: A list of UK vehicle number plate registrations

tools.name: transfer_requirements
tools.description: Given a number plate registration, explain transfer/retention requirements, likely DVLA steps, vehicle eligibility, and timescales.

registration.description: A UK vehicle number plate registration (e.g. A 1, S7 EVE, MY51 REG)

tools.name: value_registration
tools.description: Given a number plate registration, estimate its market value based on historical sales and extensive experience, and list comparable registrations offered by National Numbers.

registration.description: A UK vehicle number plate registration (e.g. A 1, S7 EVE, MY51 REG)
